title.zh: 腾讯为Agent造出1.67万套工作环境：让GLM示范，Qwen跟练
title.en: 腾讯为Agent造出1.67万套工作环境：让GLM示范，Qwen跟练

current_state.zh: Tencent Hunyuan and Fudan unveiled WorkForge, which built 16,665 verifiable, file-rich work environments to train AI agents using GLM 5.3 demonstration trajectories, lifting Qwen3.5-based models sharply on GDPval and APEX benchmarks.
current_state.en: Tencent Hunyuan and Fudan unveiled WorkForge, which built 16,665 verifiable, file-rich work environments to train AI agents using GLM 5.3 demonstration trajectories, lifting Qwen3.5-based models sharply on GDPval and APEX benchmarks.
